[b][u]Trade deal signed![/u][/b]

The council of Nordiheim is happy to anounce the signing of a new trade deal between the Empire of [nation]Yulandburg[/nation] and the United Regions Of Nordiheim.

The trade deal opens up both nations markets for the exchange of goods and services aswell as letting the Yussrians get access to Olian oil to fuel their nations hungy economy.
Nordiheim also gains access to a large lumber market while Yulandburg can buy Nordiheimian steel and fossil fuel.

The Yussrian air force are also buying 5 KJ-5H Cockatoos from Nordiheim with the latest upgrades to strenghten their air force and prepare it for the future, these fighter jets also allows Yulandburg to train their pilots for the use of newer generation fighter jets as their cocpit shares large similarities with them having been heavely modernized in 2002, the fighters are sceduled to arive right after quality tests have been done.

[spoiler=[b]Nordiheimian and Yussrian Trade deal of 26th of August 2025[/b]] [align=center][b][u]The Flying Wood Deal[/u][/b][/align]

[align=center][b]Trade and resource deal between The United Territories of Nordiheim and The Empire of Yulandburg[/b][/align]
[align=center][i]====================================================[/i][/align]

[align=center][i][u]With this trade deal the two nations of Nordiheim and Yulandburg agree to adhere to the following points:[/u][/i][/align]
[align=center][i][u]_T__________I__________M__________B__________E__________R_[/u][/i][/align]
[align=center][b][u]Fighter Jet and Destroyer Turret Blueprint Deal[/u][/b][/align]
[u][b]1.a:[/b][/u] Nordiheim agrees to sell 5 units of KJ-5H Cockatoo fighter jets to Yulandburg.

[b][u]1.b:[/u][/b] Nordiheim agrees to inspect and make sure that the 5 units of KJ-5H Cockatoo fighter jets are in propper condition for military use before delivering them to Yussrian air force.

[u][b]1.c:[/b][/u] Yulandburg will be given access to the Nordiheimian military market to buy spare parts and munitions for the KJ-5H Cockatoos as they need them.

[b][u]1.d:[/u][/b] Yulandburg will not be allowed to sell, give or donate the KJ-5H Cockatoos to other nations without first getting permission from the council of Nordiheim.

[b][u]2.a:[/u][/b] Nordiheim will sell Yulandburg the permission to use the Nordiheimian destroyer turret blueprint  "Universal DD Cannon Turret Mk.5".

[b][u]2.b:[/u][/b] By doing this Nordiheim gives Yulandburg the legal permission to build, use and sell units of this destroyer turret in their nation.

[b][u]2.c:[/u][/b] Yulandburg is legaly bond to propperly and clearly mark all destroyer turrets made from the "Universal DD Cannon Turret Mk.5" blueprint in such a way that it is easy to identified as "Made by Yulandburg".

[align=center]+++++-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+++++-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+++++[/align]
[align=center][b][u]Resource Section.[/u][/b][/align]
[u][b]3.a:[/b][/u] Nordiheim opens its resource market for Oil to Yulandburg for them to buy this resourse with currency of equal value from the  Nordiheimian oil company 'Olian Liquid Gold N.A.S.'

[b][u]3.b:[/u][/b] Yulandburg will buy an initial amount of oil valued at 450-550 million Yuboi that will be delivered over the next 3 months.

[u][b]3.c:[/b][/u] The price of oil will be based on the current world market oil prices and any new oil purchases will be done the same way on a quarterly basis.

[b][u]3.d:[/u][/b] Prices can only be renegotiated outside of the quarterly basis if someting big happens to either nation or the world market if both nations come together and mutually agree to it.

[align=center]+++++-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+++++-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+++++[/align]
[align=center][b][u]Civilian Section.[/u][/b][/align]
[b][u]4.a:[/u][/b] Both nations markets shall become open to each other for the flow and trade of general goods, luxury goods and services to encourage economic growth and prosperity.

[b][u]4.b:[/u][/b] Yulandburg will buy 2 metric tons of Hard Coal and 3 metric tons of Steel from Nordiheim at current market prices.

[b][u]4.c:[/u][/b] Nordiheim will be permited to buy sturdy Yussrian Lumber for use in its construction and production industries.

[b][u]4.d:[/u][/b] Neither nation are allowed to place tarifs or special taxes on goods or services from the other nation without both nations coming together to discuss and reach a mutual agreement of understanding and consent.

[align=center]+++++-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+++++-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+++++[/align]
[align=center][b][u]Promotion of Cooperation.[/u][/b][/align]
[b][u]5:[/u][/b] In the interest of cooperation Nordiheim declares a willingness to have the trade deal between them and Yulandburg be open to changes and/or new amendments in the future should there be need for it because of changes in either nations needs or the world scene that have a noticable effect on the original intention of 'The Flying Wood Deal' as long as both parties can arive at a mutual agreement to such changes.

[align=center]+++++-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+++++-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+++++[/align]

[align=center][color=white]+++++[/color][u][i]The Council of The United Regions of Nordiheim[/i][/u]  [color=white]++the two nations great signatories+++++++[/color]  [u][i]Trade Minister Hans Zhüpö of The Empire of Yulandburg[/i][/u][/align][/spoiler]
